sources.entry: gstack by Garry Tan - Garry Tan's (Y Combinator) Claude Code setup and "open source software factory" for managing the development lifecycle end-to-end. Includes a set of agents and in-depth skills/tools along with workflows for advancing a product from ideation to production.

summary.one_liner: gstack is a set of Markdown slash-command skills that turn Claude Code (and other coding agents) into a simulated engineering team covering planning, review, QA, security, shipping, and docs.
summary.what_it_does: Provides roughly 50 slash-command skills for Claude Code, each acting as a role such as CEO reviewer, eng manager, designer, staff engineer, QA lead, security officer, and release engineer. Skills are organized as a sprint (Think, Plan, Build, Review, Test, Ship, Reflect), with each skill writing artifacts that downstream skills read, such as /office-hours writing a design doc used by /plan-ceo-review. /review finds production bugs and auto-fixes obvious ones, /qa drives a real browser (or tests CLIs, APIs, jobs, and webhooks), and /ship runs tests and opens a PR. The README also covers a bundled browser with fallback to the Aside browser on macOS, team-mode auto-updates for shared repos, install support for multiple agent harnesses (Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Copilot CLI and others, with varying tiers), and optional GBrain persistent memory integration.
use_cases: plan and review a product idea before coding
automated code review of a branch before merge
browser-based QA testing of a staging site
ship a pull request with tests and review
design system and UI mockup generation
how_to_run: Restart Claude Code and run /office-hours to describe what you are building
Run /review on any branch with changes
Run /qa on a staging URL or local service
Run /ship to run tests, review, and open a PR
stack: Node.js (required on Windows; fallback for browse server)
notable: Role-based skill suite that chains artifacts between stages (design doc feeds plan reviews, test plan feeds QA)
Multi-agent install support: one setup script registers skills for Claude Code and several other agent harnesses, with tiered certification
Team mode bootstraps a repo so teammates auto-receive gstack updates on a stable release channel
QA works without a browser on CLIs, APIs, jobs, and webhooks
Optional /cso security audit with OWASP and STRIDE coverage and separate runtime/scanner execution via Docker
caveats: Windows requires Git Bash or WSL plus Node.js; Windows Smart App Control can block the unsigned compiled binaries, and /cso needs Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools
Aside browser is macOS-only; Linux and Windows use the bundled Chromium, and some Linux hosts need GSTACK_CHROMIUM_NO_SANDBOX=1
Many skills depend on optional external pieces such as Codex CLI, ffmpeg, Docker, or GBrain, and non-Claude hosts are mostly experimental or instruction-only
